request.prompt: Photograph this same adult professional fashion model and exact magenta swim set in a real seamless white catalogue studio. Produce a new full-length BACK photograph: the model stands upright facing directly away from the camera, both feet resting on the white studio floor, relaxed hands, back of head visible. Preserve her natural proportions, dark center-part low bun, small hoop earrings and bare feet. Preserve the opaque magenta fabric, gathered bandeau, thin halter fastening and both original side bows with their long ends. Since no historical rear exists, the simple matching gathered rear top band and matching lower rear are provisional design continuity. Use the same neutral softbox lighting and realistic textile as the reference. Frame the entire head, both hands, ties and both feet with comfortable white space, an undistorted catalogue camera and a small natural contact shadow. The native photograph should include an opaque clean white cyclorama and floor. Exactly one adult model in one photograph; no text, props, logos, graphics, border or collage. This is non-sexual commercial garment photography. Keep the outfit and coverage unchanged.
